tests.name: serialisation L3/L4 (tablets 1231) against the L3/L4 simulator > [PR-42] a query on a commissioned serial returns its lot, expiry and status: the record's lot and expiry for the serial's pool; an L3 lot or expiry that differs is a problem, never the answer

serialisation L3/L4 (tablets 1231) against the L3/L4 simulator > [PR-42][DI-31] the L3 adapter lands aggregations and decommissioning tasks; an aggregation mismatch, a parent that is no shipper of the order, a missing-events gap and a duplicate delivery each end accepted or refused with an alarm, and the period reconciles; an OPEN task keeps release red until the L3 reports it DONE

serialisation L3/L4 (tablets 1231) against the L3/L4 simulator > [PR-42] a stale L3 report refuses release: with the L3 heartbeat stopped the mirror ages past its bound and E.RECONCILIATION_SERIAL fails closed naming the stale mirror; a fresh synchronisation clears it

serialisation L3/L4 (tablets 1231) against the L3/L4 simulator > [PR-42][DI-31] malformed and stale L3 messages are refused by the receiving command; a QA rejection records the L3 system's OPEN task, and nobody else records one

serialisation L3/L4 (tablets 1231) against the L3/L4 simulator > [PR-42] the serialisation routes: a serial query through the server answers the record's lot, expiry and status; the pools of the order show the release problem; QA rejects a pool through the L3 and nobody else may
